notes: Primary 30-day AAD results from Table 3 selected. The XML table column order is Outcome measures, Total number with values, LcS group, Placebo group; the quoted row contains both arm-specific counts and denominators in that order. Arm names occur in the separate table header, not within the short numeric row spans. These are participant counts, not episode counts. Participants were adults with spinal cord injury requiring antibiotics. Randomised totals were 181 LcS and 178 placebo; Table 3 reports 257 participants with 30-day values and 102 missing. Secondary seven-day AAD results are LcS 53 /163 (32.5%) and placebo 48 /152 (31.6%). PPI subgroup results are reported separately as 19% versus 35.7% at seven days and 28% versus 52.2% at 30 days. The abstract describes the primary window as up to 30 days after finishing LcS/placebo, whereas Methods defines it relative to completion of antibiotics; the Methods/Table 3 antibiotic-based window is used here. The research-in-context box prints 44.6% versus 42.1%, unlike Table 3 and the primary-results narrative, which print 45% versus 42.1%.
